{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with the highest `sample_seq` per `patient_id`
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Confirm deduplication: should be 800 patients
assert len(df_dedup) == 800, f'Expected 800 patients, got {len(df_dedup)}'

# Check number of unique patient_ids
assert df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique() == 800, f'Expected 800 unique patient_ids, got {df_dedup["patient_id"].nunique()}'

# Print number of patients in each arm
df_dedup['arm'].value_counts()"}
